This situation is concerning, as a majority of approved applicants maintain a positive balance. Additionally, the duration of your credit request was shorter than the average, suggesting a lack of long-term financial planning. Lastly, the purpose of your loan request was for a new car, which is less common among successful applicants compared to other purposes like purchasing furniture or electronics.

Your checking account status pushed the prediction toward bad credit, while the shorter duration of your request and the specific purpose of the loan did not help your case. Additionally, reviewing your overall financial situation and seeking advice on managing your debts may also be beneficial.
